name: Alden Coria
summary: An accurate, dogged counter-striker: 3-0 in the UFC, with a short-notice stoppage of Alessandro Costa and two clear but unspectacular decisions in 2026. Sharp when opponents lead; less able to break open a slow fight.

how_they_fight.Striking: Accurate counter-striking; can do real damage when opponents get wild.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Threatens submissions (about 1.2 attempts per 15 minutes) but his takedown defense (about 45%) is a question.
how_they_fight.Defense: Composed; absorbs about 2.4 significant strikes a minute.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient; waits for the opponent to lead.

concerns: Doesn't force the action in slow fights
keys_to_beat: Don't give him easy counters: feint and take him down

sources.author: E. Spencer Kyte
